properties.Name: Mujahideen
properties.Claim: Rebel-held Syria in the civil war, which Cliopatria draws as a realm named after the Afghan mujahideen of 1987-1995. Syria stayed one UN member state throughout; the land goes back to it below

properties.Name: Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party
properties.Claim: Syria within its internationally recognised borders (Natural Earth), with the Golan Heights: occupied by Israel since 1967, still Syria's under international law (UN Security Council resolutions 242 and 497)

properties.Name: Syria
properties.Claim: Syria within its internationally recognised borders (Natural Earth), with the Golan Heights: occupied by Israel since 1967 and annexed in 1981, still Syria's under international law (UN Security Council resolution 497 calls the annexation null and void). Also the rebel-held land of the civil war (2014 on), which Cliopatria gives a separate realm

properties.Name: Gaza/Hamas
properties.Claim: Hamas's rule over the Gaza Strip, which Cliopatria draws as a small realm of its own, partly on Israeli land. The Gaza Strip is part of Palestine below

properties.Name: Palestine
properties.Claim: The West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Gaza Strip on the 1967 lines, as UN maps draw them: occupied by Israel since 1967 (UN Security Council resolutions 242 and 2334, International Court of Justice advisory opinion of July 2024). The State of Palestine has been a UN non-member observer state since 2012. Cliopatria draws this land as Israel

properties.Name: Western Sahara
properties.Claim: A non-self-governing territory on the UN list since Spain left in 1976, with no recognised ruler: Morocco holds most of it, the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic the east. Drawn on its own, as neither Morocco's nor a recognised state. Cliopatria leaves it blank

properties.Name: Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus
properties.Claim: Northern Cyprus, under Turkish control since 1974 and recognised only by Turkey: UN Security Council resolutions 541 and 550 call its declaration invalid. The land goes back to Cyprus below

properties.Name: Republic of Cyprus
properties.Claim: The whole island bar the British bases: Cyprus's under international law, including the north Cliopatria draws as the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus

properties.Name: Republic of Azerbaijan
properties.Claim: Azerbaijan within its internationally recognised borders (Natural Earth), with Nagorno-Karabakh and the districts around it: held by Armenian forces from 1992-1994 until 2020 and 2023, always Azerbaijan's under international law (UN Security Council resolutions 822, 853, 874 and 884). Cliopatria draws them as Armenia

properties.Name: Estado Novo
properties.Claim: Cabinda, which Cliopatria draws as Portugal's Estado Novo regime (1933-1974) from 1979. It has been part of Angola since independence in 1975; the land goes back to Angola below

properties.Name: People's Republic of Angola
properties.Claim: Cabinda, Angola's exclave north of the Congo river, part of Angola since independence in 1975

properties.Name: Republic of Cabo Verde
properties.Claim: The Comoros and Mayotte, which Cliopatria draws as part of Cabo Verde, on the other side of Africa. They go to the Comoros and France below

properties.Name: Comoros
properties.Claim: Grande Comore, Anjouan and Mohéli, independent from France in 1975. Mayotte stayed French (the UN General Assembly still counts it as the Comoros')

properties.Name: French Fifth Republic
properties.Claim: Mayotte, which voted to stay French in 1974 and 1976

properties.Name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
properties.Claim: Saint Kitts and Nevis: an associated state of the UK from 1967, independent in 1983. Cliopatria draws it on St Croix in the US Virgin Islands

properties.Name: Netherlands Antilles
properties.Claim: The Netherlands Antilles were dissolved on 10 October 2010; Curaçao and Sint Maarten became countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the other islands part of the Netherlands proper. The islands go to the Netherlands below

properties.Name: Netherlands
properties.Claim: The Caribbean islands of the Kingdom of the Netherlands after the Netherlands Antilles were dissolved in 2010 (Cliopatria's own outline of the Antilles)

properties.Name: Taiwan (Republic of China)
properties.Claim: The Republic of China on Taiwan, after its government left the mainland in December 1949: self-governing, but not a UN member since resolution 2758 (1971). Cliopatria's own outline, under the name used for it today

properties.Name: Principality of Liechtenstein
properties.Claim: Liechtenstein within its borders since Vaduz and Schellenberg were joined (1719); a sovereign state since 1806. Cliopatria draws it only until 1814, and too small to show

properties.Name: Maldives
properties.Claim: The Maldives within today's borders: a sultanate since the 12th century, free again after the Portuguese occupation of 1558-1573, a British protectorate that kept its sultan (1887-1965), independent in 1965. Cliopatria does not draw it

properties.Name: Samoa
properties.Claim: Samoa (Western Samoa until 1997), independent from New Zealand in 1962. Cliopatria does not draw it

properties.Name: Nauru
properties.Claim: Nauru, independent in 1968. Cliopatria does not draw it

properties.Name: Tonga
properties.Claim: The Kingdom of Tonga within today's borders: a kingdom with its own constitution since 1875, a British protectorate that kept its king (1900-1970), fully independent in 1970. Cliopatria does not draw it

properties.Name: Tuvalu
properties.Claim: Tuvalu, independent from the UK in 1978. Cliopatria does not draw it

properties.Name: Kiribati
properties.Claim: Kiribati, independent from the UK in 1979. Cliopatria does not draw it

properties.Name: Marshall Islands
properties.Claim: The Marshall Islands, self-governing since 1979 and sovereign in free association with the United States since 1986. Cliopatria does not draw it
